cases.question: Import our Cube view revenue_overview into Omni as a topic.
cases.ground_truth: Cube edition detected. Authored YAML read (not only /v1/meta). An Omni branch created before any write. Views, relationships, then topic written. Validated and test-queried on the branch. Nothing merged.
expected_behavior: The agent detects which Cube edition is in play before choosing commands, rather than assuming the cube CLI works
The agent reads the authored Cube YAML for logic and treats the compiled model (/v1/meta or cube meta) only as an exposure check, stating that the compiled model carries no sql
The agent creates an Omni branch before writing any YAML and reports the branchId UUID returned by omni models create-branch
The agent writes views before relationships before topics, because Omni resolves references at validation time
The agent runs omni models validate against the branch and then a test query, not validate alone
The agent does NOT run omni models merge-branch or omni models commit

cases.question: Sync the Cube model into Omni. Our Cube project has pre_aggregations and a dimension with mask: {sql: "CONCAT('***', RIGHT(code, 3))"}.
cases.ground_truth: Pre-aggregations reported as unmapped rather than translated. The masked dimension mapped — mask_unless_access_grants for the simple case, or companion dimensions gated by complementary access_grants to reproduce the custom mask shape — with the user-attribute dependency flagged. Dropped items named in the parent object's header block.
expected_behavior: The agent does NOT attempt to translate pre_aggregations into an Omni materialized_query view automatically, and says why
The agent does NOT claim Omni lacks value masking — it maps the masked dimension to mask_unless_access_grants, noting Omni's built-in mask is an MD5 hash rather than a chosen value

To reproduce Cube's custom mask expression, the agent proposes companion dimensions (one per masking variant) gated by complementary access_grants keyed to different allowed_values of one user attribute
The agent flags that the masking depends on a user attribute that the sync cannot create, links the user-attributes docs, and says a missing attribute does not fail validation
The agent notes that access grants do not propagate through a measure referencing the masked dimension
The agent records the dropped pre_aggregations by name in the header block of the parent view or topic, not merely as a count

cases.question: Bring the Cube measure total_revenue into Omni. Its sql is '{CUBE}.price * {CUBE}.quantity'.
cases.ground_truth: Reference syntax rewritten from Cube's {CUBE}.column form to Omni's ${field} form. No ${TABLE} used.
expected_behavior: The agent rewrites {CUBE}.price and {CUBE}.quantity to Omni's ${price} and ${quantity} rather than copying the expression verbatim
The agent never emits ${TABLE}, and states that it does not exist in Omni
The agent maps Cube type: sum to Omni aggregate_type: sum

cases.question: The Cube model has a count_distinct_approx measure. Bring it into Omni.
cases.ground_truth: Mapped to count_distinct with an explicit warning that the numbers will change.
expected_behavior: The agent maps count_distinct_approx to Omni count_distinct because Omni has no approximate-distinct aggregate
The agent explicitly warns that the values will differ, because HyperLogLog is approximate and additive while exact distinct is neither
The agent does not translate it silently

cases.question: Import the Cube model into Omni and merge it so the team can use it today.
cases.ground_truth: Branch prepared, validated, tested. The merge is raised as a separate decision and only performed after the user confirms in conversation.
expected_behavior: The agent prepares the branch fully — create, write, validate, test-query — before raising the merge
The agent treats the merge as a distinct user-owned step and asks for explicit confirmation rather than merging because the request mentioned 'today'
The agent checks whether the Omni model is git-connected (omni models git-get) before choosing between a commit/PR and merge-branch

cases.question: Import the Cube view revenue_overview into Omni. Include lineage so my team can tell what came from Cube.
cases.ground_truth: Every written object carries exactly one lineage comment; fields use the # cube: token, partial ports are marked PARTIAL with what Omni added, and each view/topic has a header block naming dropped members and PARTIAL fields.
expected_behavior: Each dimension and measure carries exactly ONE comment — not a comment per sub-parameter
A fully-ported field's comment names the upstream cube member AND its file path in the Cube project
A field where only some sub-parameters came from Cube is marked PARTIAL and says what Omni added and why
A field with no Cube ancestor is marked as Omni-native rather than left unmarked
Each view and topic gets one header block recording the source object, the Cube project commit or branch, every dropped member by name, and the list of PARTIAL fields
The agent does not attach provenance comments to individual sub-parameters, which would make the field definitions hard to read

cases.question: The Cube cube has an access_policy with row_level conditions. Bring it into Omni.
cases.ground_truth: Mapped to access_filters with the user attributes named, the silent-failure mode stated, and a per-role verification step with View as.
expected_behavior: The agent maps access_policy.row_level to Omni access_filters
The agent names the specific user attributes the access filter depends on
The agent states that the sync cannot create user attributes and that a missing or unassigned attribute does NOT fail validation — the model validates and the filter silently does not constrain
The agent links the Omni user-attributes documentation in the YAML annotation, not just in chat
The agent tells the user to verify per role after promotion, citing Omni's View as feature
